subject: Re: MAVE kickoff — pilot decision + wrap-up
body:
Team,

Wrapping the window. Decisions:

1) The slip was the right call. The 05-22 pilot report with the mined hard negatives shows 91.3 precision / 88.1 recall on the pilot vertical — the catalog team accepted it and wants a second vertical in Q3.
2) Scope cut confirmed: multi-vertical rollout and the negatives-mining automation both move to Q3. I'm writing them into the OKR draft this week so they're in before the planning lock.
3) Jorge's pinned container (tf-models-official 2.7.0) becomes the blessed image for any Q3 follow-on — nobody re-fights that dependency.

As discussed, any post-window extraction re-runs wait for the Corpus v2 migration to complete; our schedule already assumed the pre-freeze cutoff, so nothing changes there.

Thanks all — clean landing.

Dmitri
